narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to raise awareness about the hygiene of reusable water bottles by comparing their bacteria levels to household items and pet bowls. It provides practical demonstrations on how to thoroughly clean various parts and materials of water bottles, and warns about the potential health risks of using plastic bottles with hot water or exposing them to heat.
